title: Dynamic-video fMRI encoding
scientific_question: Can a frozen video-feature encoder predict prepared fMRI response estimates for held-out videos within each participant, beyond matched static/motion/time controls?
primary_outputs: Private prepared trial/video response estimates in a frozen coordinate/ROI space and processing branch; not a published correlation number.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

primary.name: Participant-macro held-video response correlation
primary.aggregation: Prospective complete-participant/ROI coordinate-mean Pearson correlation using a frozen finite/constant-coordinate policy; mean ROIs within person then people. The current absent grader does not authenticate this formula.
primary.rationale: Matches the registered encoding target while making the missing implementation parity explicit; no source-transport success is substituted for prediction accuracy.
